status: PROVISIONAL -- feasibility/method result, NOT a validated genuine profile
relationship_to_stage1: Independent, narrower-scope refreeze. gmt_12_triangle_profile.json (Stage 1) is NOT modified, overwritten, or superseded by this file -- both remain valid records of their own methodology and evidence. Stage 3 differs from Stage 1 in three ways: (1) the calibration population is the phase-2 expanded set (10 watches contributing overall, 9 with >=1 image at <=10deg apparent tilt) rather than Stage 1's n=2; (2) the PRIMARY population for this freeze is restricted to <=10deg apparent tilt only, per the reconciled research notes' practical-viewpoint policy -- >10deg images were used only as stress-test comparisons, never to compute a frozen band; (3) each radial feature uses whichever normalisation (simple/affine or projective-corrected) the calibration data actually supports, per feature, rather than one global choice; orientation is represented by an incidence-first residual (does the observed symmetry axis pass through the independently established dial centre) in addition to the existing tangential-offset feature, rather than by a standalone Euclidean angle alone.

calibration_population.warning: 9 independent physical watches is a real improvement over Stage 1 (n=2) but is still a small-sample research population, not a validated manufacturing tolerance. All 7 of the newly-sourced watches contributing here come from a single marketplace channel (1stDibs) -- see the phase 2 write-up's provenance-diversity caveat. gen_1stdibs_j14512702 and gen_1stdibs_j25758762 are part of the phase-2 expanded set but contribute no <=10deg image and so do not appear in this primary population; they remain available as >10deg stress evidence where applicable.

not_authenticated_ground_truth: gen_candidate means source-labelled genuine candidate only, per this project's standing rule. Not independently authenticated.

methodology.primary_tilt_restriction: Every selected_core_features band below is computed ONLY from images at <=10 degrees apparent tilt (the practical-viewpoint policy's Mode A / ordinary dealer QC view). Images above 10 degrees were summarised separately (see stress_test_gt10deg on each feature) purely as a robustness comparison and never contributed to any median, MAD, range, or stability check below.
methodology.hybrid_normalisation_policy: Each radial feature (apex/centre/base) independently uses whichever of the simple (affine-only) or projective (perspective-corrected, fit per-photo from the round-marker peer corridor) coordinate the <=10deg calibration data actually supports -- see each feature's 'normalisation' and the simple-vs-projective comparison recorded in known_limitations. This is not one global transform choice.
methodology.incidence_first_orientation: axis_incidence_canonical tests whether the observed apex-to-base symmetry line, extended, passes through the dial centre already established independently of the triangle (canonical origin by construction) -- a translation-sensitive incidence residual -- rather than relying only on the line's raw angle.
methodology.stability_checks: Every selected_core_features entry passed two checks before being retained: (1) leave-one-physical-watch-out (LOWO) -- the largest change in the population median when any single one of the 9 primary watches is excluded and the statistic recomputed; (2) hierarchical/watch-level bootstrap (2000 resamples, physical_watch_id as the independence unit, each resampled watch's own usable <=10deg images additionally resampled with replacement) -- reported as the bootstrap distribution's IQR. The stated, non-arbitrary bar applied here: LOWO max median shift <= the feature's own population MAD (removing any one watch should not move the estimate by more than the typical between-watch spread already observed). All candidates tested passed this bar at n=9; feature selection below was therefore made on parsimony/redundancy grounds (matching Stage 1's own precedent), not by discarding an unstable candidate. Full numbers for every candidate tested (including ones not selected) are in gmt_stage3_stability_analysis.json.
methodology.no_hard_thresholds: This freeze step defines expected-genuine geometry BANDS only, exactly as Stage 1. No pass/fail boundary, defect threshold, or authenticity signal is created here.

selected_core_features.name: apex_r_simple
selected_core_features.definition: 12-triangle apex point, affine-normalised canonical radial coordinate along the independently-established 12 axis.
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: canonical dial-radius units (master.MINUTE_TRACK_R=0.891, master.DIAL_EDGE_R=1.0); r=0 at dial centre.

stress_test_gt10deg.note: Stress-only, not part of this freeze. Very close to the <=10deg median -- apex_r_simple shows the least apparent tilt sensitivity of the radial candidates tested.

selected_core_features.why_simple_not_projective: Consistent with phase 2's own finding: at n=10, simple was ~4.6x tighter than projective for apex specifically (this <=10deg-restricted refreeze confirms the same direction -- projective apex MAD was not tighter here either). Simple is the supported choice for apex per the hybrid policy.
selected_core_features.known_limitations: n=9 physical watches, single-marketplace-dominated new sourcing (see calibration_population.warning). Population max (0.619) sits well above p90 (0.567) -- a small number of watches/images pull the upper tail; MAD (the robust statistic this band is built from) is not affected by this, but it is recorded for transparency.

selected_core_features.name: centre_r_projective
selected_core_features.definition: 12-triangle centroid point, projective-corrected canonical radial coordinate (fit per-photo from the round-marker peer corridor's inner/centre/outer conics along the 12 axis; the triangle itself contributes nothing to that fit).
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: canonical dial-radius units, projective-corrected; r=0 at dial centre.

stress_test_gt10deg.note: Stress-only. Median shifts noticeably lower and MAD widens ~4x above 10deg -- centre_r_projective's stability is demonstrated inside the <=10deg operating range this profile is scoped to, not beyond it.

selected_core_features.why_projective_not_simple: centre_r_simple's MAD at <=10deg was 0.0290 (9 watches) vs projective's 0.0056 (8 watches) -- roughly 5x tighter, and LOWO shift is over 20x smaller (0.0005 vs 0.0106). Projective is clearly the supported choice for centre per the hybrid policy. Coverage cost: 1 fewer watch (8 vs 9) because projective requires a sufficiently conditioned round-marker corridor fit.
selected_core_features.known_limitations: Requires a well-conditioned projective fit (>=5 round markers, corridor sufficiently well fit); unavailable on some otherwise-usable photos. n=8 watches, single-marketplace-dominated new sourcing.

selected_core_features.name: base_r_projective
selected_core_features.definition: 12-triangle base-centre point, projective-corrected canonical radial coordinate (same per-photo corridor fit as centre_r_projective).
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: canonical dial-radius units, projective-corrected; r=0 at dial centre.

stress_test_gt10deg.note: Stress-only; n=3 watches is too thin to draw a tilt-dependence conclusion from the >10deg MAD alone.

selected_core_features.why_projective_not_simple: base_r_simple's MAD at <=10deg was 0.0270 (9 watches) vs projective's 0.0036 (8 watches) -- roughly 7.5x tighter, matching (and sharpening, under the <=10deg restriction) phase 2's overall finding that projective is the stronger form for base. Projective is the supported choice for base per the hybrid policy.
selected_core_features.known_limitations: Same corridor-availability coverage cost as centre_r_projective (n=8, not 9). Single-marketplace-dominated new sourcing.

selected_core_features.name: axis_incidence_canonical
selected_core_features.definition: Signed, length-normalised perpendicular distance from the canonical origin (the independently established dial centre) to the line through the triangle's apex and base-centre canonical points. Zero means the observed symmetry axis, extended, passes exactly through the dial centre -- the incidence-first orientation test recommended by the reconciled research notes, primarily sensitive to sideways (tangential) TRANSLATION of the whole marker rather than rotation about its own centroid.
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: dimensionless (canonical length units normalised by the apex-to-base canonical distance); 0 = axis passes exactly through the dial centre.

stress_test_gt10deg.note: Stress-only. Median moves further from zero and MAD roughly triples above 10deg -- consistent with this being a genuinely viewpoint-sensitive residual outside the primary operating range, as expected for any incidence-style measurement.

selected_core_features.known_limitations: NEW feature, first calibration exposure this phase (no Stage-1 precedent to cross-check against). p90 (0.084) is far from the median (0.004) and driven by a small number of watches/images -- at n=9 this tail is not resolvable from noise yet; the MAD-based useful_central_range this profile actually uses for the verdict is more robust to this than p10/p90 would be, but p90 is reported as-is rather than hidden. Bootstrap IQR (0.013) is about 2x the direct MAD, the widest ratio of any retained feature -- flagged, not disqualifying under the stated LOWO<=MAD bar, but this feature's band should be treated as the least mature of the five retained.

selected_core_features.name: centroid_tangential_offset_canonical
selected_core_features.definition: Signed tangential (perpendicular-to-axis) canonical displacement of the triangle's contour centroid from the nominal 12 axis. Positive = clockwise.
selected_core_features.coordinate_system: canonical dial-radius units, 0 = exactly on the nominal 12 axis.

stress_test_gt10deg.note: Stress-only. MAD widens more than 10x above 10deg -- this feature's stability is specifically a <=10deg-operating-range result, matching the practical-viewpoint policy's expectation.

selected_core_features.known_limitations: Retained from Stage 1 (where, at n=2, it showed an apparent left/right bias later shown by phase 2's n=10 to likely be small-sample noise); this <=10deg-restricted n=9 refreeze continues to show a near-zero, reasonably stable median. Single-marketplace-dominated new sourcing.

secondary_reported_not_core.name: centre_r_simple
secondary_reported_not_core.reason: Retained for comparison only; projective form is materially tighter and more LOWO-stable at <=10deg (see centre_r_projective.why_projective_not_simple).

secondary_reported_not_core.name: base_r_simple
secondary_reported_not_core.reason: Retained for comparison only; projective form is materially tighter and more LOWO-stable at <=10deg (see base_r_projective.why_projective_not_simple).

secondary_reported_not_core.name: apex_tangential_offset_canonical
secondary_reported_not_core.reason: Passed the same stability bar as the core orientation features (LOWO shift 0.0034 <= MAD 0.0068), but overlaps substantially with centroid_tangential_offset_canonical for the purpose of a single sideways-placement verdict; kept as secondary/diagnostic evidence for the translation-vs-rotation signed-endpoint pattern (see the diagnostic panel and overlay), not promoted to the core five to keep the profile small.

secondary_reported_not_core.name: base_tangential_offset_canonical
secondary_reported_not_core.reason: Same as apex_tangential_offset_canonical -- passed stability, kept as secondary translation-vs-rotation diagnostic evidence rather than a sixth core feature.

secondary_reported_not_core.name: symmetry_axis_angular_deviation_deg
secondary_reported_not_core.reason: Retained from Stage 1 as secondary; the reconciled research notes explicitly prefer the incidence-first axis test (axis_incidence_canonical, now core) over a standalone Euclidean angle where practical. Still reported because it captures rotation about the marker's own centroid, which axis_incidence_canonical (translation-sensitive) does not directly test.

secondary_reported_not_core.name: base_width_over_height
secondary_reported_not_core.reason: Shape evidence is explicitly secondary only per this phase's scope, regardless of its own stability (it did pass the same LOWO/bootstrap bar as the core features).

explicit_non_definitions.no_defect_thresholds: This file defines expected genuine geometry BANDS only. It does not define, imply, or compute any pass/fail boundary.
explicit_non_definitions.no_authenticity_score: This file makes no authenticity, GL/RL, factory, or combined-quality determination.
explicit_non_definitions.no_android_or_production_use: Not wired into any production code path.
explicit_non_definitions.no_validation_use: This freeze used calibration-split gen_candidate data exclusively. No validation-split watch (genuine or replica) was inspected, measured, or used to derive any number in this file.
